sam: Heads up team 1: we're scheduling a narrow-slice rolling reboot to address persistent thermal-throttle spikes on rack M4 in eu-west1. Window: Mon 2026-06-21 23:00-00:30 UTC. Plan is low-risk sequential host reboots with KV-cache warmback, not a full pool drain. Goal: reduce tail latency and avoid broad failover.

nadia: Acknowledged. Which hosts are in the slice and any pinned Dedicated tenants?

sam: Hosts m4-21..m4-28 (8 hosts) in mixed-gpu slab. Pinned Dedicated: tenant-realtime-3 on m4-24. We'll attempt live-migrate containers off m4-24 first; if LM fails, we'll schedule a short graceful drain and failover to warm reserve.

kai: Quick LM probe queued: `./scripts/lm-check --pool eu-west1-mixed-m4 --hosts m4-21..m4-28 --timeout 30s`. Will paste results in 10m.

lucas: Ops plan (concise):
- set maintenance tag: `infractl maintenance add --hosts m4-21..m4-28 --reason "thermal-surgical-reboot"`
- bump pool cushion: `autoscalectl set-cushion --pool eu-west1-mixed-m4 --cushion 20% --until 2026-06-22T01:00:00Z`
- pre-warm 2 spare nodes in same AZ: `infractl node warmup --region eu-west1 --count 2`
- per-host sequence: `for h in m4-21..m4-28; do infractl drain $h --grace 90 || mark-manual && reboot $h && sleep 420; done`
- KV cache seed: seed top-10 prefixes to spares during gap windows
- monitor: 95p latency + gpu-util + nvlink errors; abort threshold: sustained 5xx >1.8x baseline for 7m

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1355 and added calendar entry. Notifying tenant-relations-bot to prepare customer note for Dedicated tenants.

sam: Action items: kai paste LM output; nadia publish host->tenant map and opt-outs; lucas coordinate spare warmup and autoscale cushion; finance estimate cost delta if cross-AZ burst needed.

kai: LM probe results: 6/8 hosts passed. m4-26 and m4-27 show LM reject with `nvml: handshake timeout` in probe. Recommendation: exclude m4-26/m4-27 from automated LM and plan manual drain for them. Full logs uploaded to INFRA-1355.

nadia: Host->tenant map uploaded. Opt-outs: tenant-sensitive-5 flagged (compliance) and marked to be excluded from automation unless they explicitly opt-in.

finance: Quick cost note: if we need cross-AZ burst to eu-west2 for spill traffic, estimate +15% serving cost for the 90m window. We have a 20k burst buffer; log actuals to infra cost center.

sre-oncall: I'll be watching health channels during the window. If embedding or rerank routes show latency > 200ms increase for >5m, we'll divert traffic to warm nodes and escalate.

sam: Right, we'll keep the sequence tight and only use reserve lanes if latency or 5xx thresholds hit. I'll draft the Dedicated customer note and ping tenant-relations-bot for approval. Any objections?

lucas: One small ask: increase metrics scrape frequency for gpu temp and nvlink errors to 30s for the window. Command: `telemetryctl set-interval --metric gpu_temp,nvlink_errors --interval 30s --until 2026-06-22T01:00:00Z`

sam: Good call, lucas done.

kai: Noted. I'll also tag m4-26/27 for post-maint manual driver handshake and schedule a firmware micro-update if reconnect flakiness persists.

sam: Thanks. Final checklist: publish comms 24h out, pre-warm spares, bump cushion, exclude opt-outs, exclude m4-26/27 from LM automation, SRE oncall ready. Closing loop and attaching runbook to INFRA-1355. :white_check_mark:
